invalidMove.question: I entered a correct move but got "Invalid move" error.
invalidMove.answer: When two pieces of the same type (like knights or rooks) can move to the same square, you need to specify which piece to move explicitly, such as Ngf3 or Rad8. You can enable the legal moves display in <settingsLink>settings</settingsLink> to help with this.

ads.question: Why are there advertisements on this site?
ads.answer: This service is provided free of charge, but maintaining servers and domains incurs costs. Ad revenue helps cover these expenses. If ads bother you, you can disable them in <settingsLink>settings</settingsLink>.

chessEngine.question: What chess engine does the AI use?

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Our privacy policy and how we handle your personal information
privacy.introduction: Blindfold Chess ("the Site") respects user privacy and is committed to protecting personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how the Site collects, uses, and protects information.
privacy.cookiesDescription: The Site uses cookies to improve service quality and deliver advertisements. Cookies are small text files stored on your device by websites. While you can disable cookies, some features may not function properly.
privacy.analyticsDescription: The Site uses Google Analytics to understand site usage and improve services. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect the following information:
privacy.analyticsItem1: Access statistics such as visitor count and page views
privacy.analyticsItem2: Behavior patterns and time spent on the site
privacy.analyticsPrivacyPolicy: Data collected by Google Analytics is managed according to Google's Privacy Policy. For details, please see:
privacy.adsenseDescription: The Site uses Google AdSense as an advertising service. Google AdSense uses cookies to deliver personalized ads based on user interests. The following information may be used:
privacy.adsenseItem1: Past access information to this site and other sites
privacy.adsenseItem2: IP address (does not contain personally identifiable information)
privacy.adsenseOptOut: If you do not want personalized ads delivered, you can change your settings at:
privacy.adsenseLearnMore: For more information about how Google uses information for advertising on partner sites, please see:
privacy.partnerSitesLink: How Google uses information from sites or apps that use our services
privacy.localStorageDescription: The Site uses browser local storage for the following purposes:
privacy.localStorageItem1: Saving game progress and user settings
privacy.localStorageNote: This information is stored only on your device and is not transmitted to external servers. You can delete this information at any time by clearing your browser cache.
privacy.personalDataDescription: The Site does not provide user registration or contact forms, and does not directly collect personally identifiable information such as names, email addresses, or phone numbers.
privacy.thirdPartyLinksDescription: The Site may contain links to external sites. The Site is not responsible for the privacy policies of these external sites. When visiting external sites, please review their respective privacy policies.
privacy.childrenPrivacyDescription: The Site does not intentionally collect personal information from children under 13 years of age. Parents should appropriately supervise their children's internet use.
privacy.changesDescription: The Site may update this Privacy Policy as needed. Updated Privacy Policy will take effect from the time it is posted on this page. Please check this page regularly.

terms.dataHandlingItem5: When the Service changes data storage methods or specifications
